bullets: Formulated to Support Immune and Digestive Health
GMP - Good Manufacturing Practice Consistent Quality
11 strain digestive health formula with 50 Billion live cultures†.
Helps maintain intestinal comfort and digestive health.
May help with occasional gas and bloating.
Delayed release capsule protects the probiotics from stomach acid to help ensure the bacteria are delivered to your intestinal tract alive.
paragraphs: †This product guarantees a minimum potency of 14 Billion CFU per serving until expiration date.

blocks.label: Suggested use
paragraphs: Adults take one (1) capsule a day. May be taken with or without food, best if taken on an empty stomach thirty (30) minutes before a meal.

blocks.label: Other ingredients
paragraphs: Hypromellose (delayed release capsule), cellulose, rice fiber, rice extract blend.
Does not contain: GMOs, soy, gluten, dairy, eggs, fish, shellfish, tree nuts, peanuts or preservatives.

blocks.label: Warnings
paragraphs: Keep out of reach of children. As with any supplement, if you are pregnant, nursing or taking medication, consult your doctor before using this product. Store in a cool, dry place.
Do not use if safety seal under the lid is broken or missing.
